data.name: Settings_HowItWorks_1
data.value: • RebootWhy holds a "display required" request, just like video players do. Windows Update sees that the user is at the computer and postpones the restart.

data.name: Settings_HowItWorks_2
data.value: • Until the wait is over, the screen does not turn off and the computer does not go to sleep on its own.

data.name: Settings_HowItWorks_3
data.value: • The protection works while RebootWhy is running (the icon in the notification area).

data.name: Settings_HowItWorks_4
data.value: • RebootWhy does not block your own actions: "Restart" or "Shut down" from the Start menu work as usual.

data.name: Settings_HowItWorks_5
data.value: • The most reliable option is to restart yourself at a convenient moment: then the wait is over.

data.name: Settings_KeepActive_Hint
